integrity: The mathematical proof covers every positive integer pair. Standalone finite exhaustive checks are corroborating evidence, not a substitute for the proof. Priority comparison remains subject to specialist-source coverage limits.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to double stars with at least one leaf on each side, the non-normalized induced-distance score vector (1,0,-1), and Nash deviations that are strictly profitable for the moving agent. Does not prove general-tree or normalized-model assertions.
title: Exact Nash spectrum and linear welfare loss on double-star distance games
